name: Question list
summary: An editable list of collapsible questions laid out as the settings lab's QuestionList — a SettingRow head with the question count, a Collapse per question (header slots, an interactive body slot, optional status line, prompt field plus OptionRow choices), and full-width secondary Add option / Add question buttons (SETTINGS-31/36), plus the host API a slide's settings need: notices, single-open accordion with a toggle intent, a leave event, named edits, single-correct, multi-line prompts, test ids and in-place updates that keep focus.
highlights: A Collapse per question: “N. prompt” header with before / after / marker slots and an optional status line, prompt field, OptionRow choices
Host API: notices, accordion + question-toggle, question-leave, named edits, in-place updates
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-question-list> — the composite settings surface for an editable list of questions (SETTINGS-31/36), laid out as the settings lab's QuestionList and composed only from DS components. The head is a SettingRow: the list label (with an optional "?" help) LEFT and the "N questions" count RIGHT. Each question is a bordered DS Collapse whose header reads "N. <prompt>" ("Untitled question" while empty) wrapping to at most two lines (then an ellipsis), with header slots at five positions (`start-<id>` after the caret, `marker-<id>` in place of the number, `before-<id>` / `after-<id>` either side of the prompt, `end-<id>` at the trailing edge), a `body-<id>` slot for interactive content above the "Question" row of the open body, an optional status line under the header (a warning or error tone also recolours the card border), and a secondary small trash Button with a "Delete question" tooltip centred on the card's top-right corner, revealed on hover or keyboard focus and a Tab stop, exactly like OptionRow's delete; inside, a stacked SettingRow "Question" over a CountedInput, then a stacked SettingRow "Options" over the question's OptionRows (drag handle, correct toggle, optional image with `allowimage`) and a full-width "Add option" AddItemButton. A full-width "Add question" AddItemButton sits under the list. Limits: the add buttons disable at `max` / `maxoptions`, the deletes at `min` / `minoptions` (SETTINGS-36). Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. Emits composed `change` CustomEvent<{questions, edit}> on every edit; `edit` is `{ type, questionId, optionId? }` (prompt | option-text | option-correct | option-add | option-delete | question-add | question-delete). For a host that owns the model (a slide type's settings): `notices` renders InfoBoxes between the head and the questions, with links that open a question; `accordion` keeps one question open; a header click or notice link fires a cancelable `question-toggle` first; `setQuestionOpen(id, open)` opens one from code; `question-leave` fires when focus or a press moves out of a question; `multiline` makes the prompt a 1 to 3 row CountedTextarea; `singlecorrect` keeps exactly one correct option; `testid` stamps data-testid hooks; and setting `questions` again with the same ids updates the fields in place, so the caret and focus survive a host that writes every edit back.
codeNote: A composite element that COMPOSES DS components — SettingRow, Collapse, CountedInput, OptionRow, AddItemButton, FieldError, InfoBox, Button and Tooltip — never re-implementing them. Set the model as a property (`el.questions = [...]`) or a JSON attribute. React (< 19) via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds natively. Header slots are light-DOM children keyed by question id (`<aha-tag slot="before-q1">00:23</aha-tag>`); put only non-interactive content there, since the header is a button. Interactive content goes in the body slot `body-<id>` (open question body, above the "Question" row). A host that keeps its own model listens to `change` (read `e.detail.edit` to know what changed), `question-toggle` and `question-leave`, and writes `el.questions` back freely: the same ids in the same order patch in place, so focus and the caret stay put. Never hand-assemble this list from Collapse, InfoBox and FieldError in a slide: what it lacks is added here.

spec.label: Head
spec.value: SettingRow: label 14/21 regular (+ optional "?" help) LEFT, "N questions" count 12/18 #4A4A4A RIGHT

spec.label: Notices
spec.value: `notices`: InfoBoxes (info, warning, error) 8px under the head and 8px apart, in a polite live region; each paragraph is text with optional inline links (a plain `<a href="#id">` in the Alert link style: message size, --aha-text-link, underline) that open and reveal a question

spec.label: Question
spec.value: bordered DS Collapse, caret leading, header "N. <prompt>" (14 regular on --aha-gray-15), the prompt wrapping to at most two lines, then an ellipsis; open state kept per question (`open` in the model; a new question opens)

spec.label: Header slots
spec.value: `start-<id>` (right after the caret), `marker-<id>` (replaces the "N." number; hidden "Question N" name kept), `before-<id>` / `after-<id>` (either side of the prompt), `end-<id>` (trailing edge); any number of children per slot, 6px apart, items top-aligned to the first line, slotted items never shrink, the prompt wraps to two lines then ellipsises

spec.label: Body slot
spec.value: `body-<id>`: interactive light-DOM children in the open body of question `<id>`, above the "Question" row; clicks, keys and edits there never toggle the collapse; hidden (not focusable) while closed; follows the question by id

spec.label: Status
spec.value: `status: { message, tone }` renders a FieldError under the header row, collapsed and open: info = muted text, warning = glyph + secondary grey, error = glyph + default text. Warning and error also recolour the card border (--aha-border-warning / --aha-border-error, same 1px width; the DS status tokens carry no hue); info does not. Hooks: `data-tone` and part `question-warning` / `question-error`

spec.label: Delete
spec.value: secondary small icon Button (28, system-trash) with a "Delete question" tooltip, centred on the card's top-right corner (-14px), hidden until the question is hovered or has focus (or the button itself is focused), exactly OptionRow's delete: same position, 0.1s opacity transition, a Tab stop that Enter / Space activates; disabled at min

spec.label: Body
spec.value: stacked SettingRow "Question" + CountedInput (`promptmaxlength`, default 120; with `multiline` a CountedTextarea of 1 to 3 rows), then stacked SettingRow "Options" + OptionRows (orderable, correctable, image with allowimage, `optionmaxlength` default 80) + full-width "Add option"

spec.label: Add question
spec.value: full-width AddItemButton (the secondary Button, 36 high), 12px under the list, disabled at max (SETTINGS-31)

spec.label: Limits
spec.value: no "X of Y" counter — the add buttons disable at max / maxoptions, the deletes at min / minoptions (SETTINGS-36)

spec.label: Open state
spec.value: `accordion`: at most one question open. A header click or notice link fires cancelable `question-toggle` {id, index, open, source} first; `setQuestionOpen(id, open)` changes it from code with no event. Per-question `current: true` gives the header the Collapse's selected look

spec.label: Host updates
spec.value: setting `questions` with the same question and option ids in the same order patches the fields, title, open state, status and current in place (focus and caret kept); any other change rebuilds

props.name: questions
props.desc: The model; set as a property or a JSON attribute. `open` starts that question expanded; `status` adds the supporting line (tone info | warning | error, default info). `current` gives the header the selected look (the question at the playhead, say); `untitled` replaces the "Untitled question" header text while the prompt is empty. Setting it again with the same question and option ids in the same order updates in place, keeping focus

props.name: slot="start-<id>"
props.desc: Content right after the caret of question `<id>`, before the number; never shrinks

props.name: slot="marker-<id>"
props.desc: Replaces the "N." number of question `<id>` (an Icon, say); the header keeps a hidden "Question N" name

props.name: slot="before-<id>"
props.desc: Content before the prompt of question `<id>` (a Tag with the time, say); never shrinks

props.name: slot="after-<id>"
props.desc: Content after the prompt of question `<id>`; never shrinks

props.name: slot="end-<id>"
props.desc: Content at the trailing edge of the header of question `<id>`; never shrinks. Every slot takes any number of children

props.name: slot="body-<id>"
props.desc: INTERACTIVE content (a SettingRow with a time input and stepper, say) inside the open body of question `<id>`, above the "Question" row. Focusable and clickable; clicks, keys and edits in it never toggle the collapse. Hidden while the question is closed; follows its question by id across reorder, add and delete, and an id with no question renders nothing

props.name: label
props.desc: The list label in the head row

props.name: help
props.desc: Adds the "?" help tooltip after the label

props.name: min
props.desc: Minimum questions — delete disables at this count

props.name: max
props.desc: Maximum questions — +Add disables at this count

props.name: minoptions
props.desc: Minimum options per question — option delete disables at this count

props.name: maxoptions
props.desc: Maximum options per question — +Add option disables at this count

props.name: allowimage
props.desc: Give every option the per-option image control; its image-add/change/edit/delete intents bubble out

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Disable adding questions

props.name: notices
props.desc: InfoBoxes between the head and the questions (property only). tone info | warning | error; each paragraph is a string or an array of strings and `{ question: id, label }` links, which open that question (firing question-toggle with source "notice") and scroll it into view

props.name: accordion
props.desc: At most one question open: opening one closes the others

props.name: multiline
props.desc: The prompt field is a CountedTextarea that grows from 1 to 3 rows instead of a CountedInput

props.name: promptmaxlength
props.desc: Character limit of the prompt field

props.name: optionmaxlength
props.desc: Character limit of each option

props.name: singlecorrect
props.desc: Exactly one correct option per question: marking one unmarks the others, and the marked one cannot be unmarked

props.name: testid
props.desc: Prefix for data-testid hooks: <prefix>-count, -notice-<tone>, -item-<id>, -title-<id>, -status-<id>, -delete-<id>, -prompt-<id>, -option-<optionId>, -add-option-<id>, -add-question. Cards always carry data-question-id and option rows data-option-id

props.name: setQuestionOpen(id, open = true)
props.desc: Opens or closes a question from code (honours accordion); fires no question-toggle

props.name: strings
props.desc: Translated copy for the list's and its option rows' built-in strings. Keys: countOne / countOther ("{count} question(s)"), plus countZero / countTwo / countFew / countMany picked by Intl.PluralRules for the page language, addQuestion, question, options, addOption, deleteQuestion (tooltip), deleteQuestionN ("Delete question {n}"), questionN ("Question {n}"), untitledQuestion, questionPlaceholder, correctAnswer (the options' correct-toggle name), markAsCorrect (that name on an option not marked correct; defaults to correctAnswer), optionPlaceholder, deleteOption, deleteOptionHint, reorderOption, reorderOptionHint (the option rows' field, delete and drag-handle copy; the optional image control keeps its own copy). A missing key keeps its English default

props.name: question-add
props.desc: Cancelable, composed intent fired when Add question is activated, before the list changes; detail.index is the end of the list. preventDefault() makes the host insert the question itself (at a video playhead, say) by setting el.questions; otherwise the list adds a blank question and emits change

props.name: question-delete
props.desc: Cancelable, composed intent fired when a question's delete is activated, before the list changes; detail.question is the question about to be removed, so a host can offer Undo. preventDefault() makes the host handle removal; otherwise the list removes it and emits change

props.name: question-toggle
props.desc: Cancelable, composed intent fired before a header click (source "header") or a notice link (source "notice") opens or closes a question; preventDefault() keeps it as it was

props.name: question-leave
props.desc: Composed, fired once each time focus or a pointer press moves out of a question it was in (its card and its slotted content count as inside), or that question closes; the moment to save or validate it

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event on any edit; e.detail.questions is the full model and e.detail.edit names the edit: { type: prompt | option-text | option-correct | option-add | option-delete | question-add | question-delete, questionId, optionId? }

whenToUse.when: an editable set of questions, each with its own prompt + choices (a quiz builder, a survey)
a flat list of options for ONE question — compose OptionRow directly

opinion.note: The add buttons span the full panel width (SETTINGS-31) — never hugged to one side. The "N questions" count is a total, never an "X of Y" (SETTINGS-36): the add buttons disable at max and the deletes at min. Header slots take non-interactive content only (the header is a button; use `body-<id>` for interactive content), and the status line is for state, not validation of the prompt field. Composes SettingRow, Collapse, CountedInput, OptionRow, AddItemButton and FieldError; it does not re-implement any of them. A slide type's settings use this list with `notices`, `accordion`, `multiline`, `singlecorrect` and the toggle and leave events; a missing feature is added here, never hand-assembled from Collapse, InfoBox and FieldError.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the settings-lab QuestionList mapped into the DS: an Ant Collapse per question in the lab, the DS Collapse here; the lab's SettingRow + Input prompt, OptionRow answers and default-Button adds are the DS SettingRow, CountedInput, OptionRow and AddItemButton. The question header takes the lab's look through the Collapse's `head` part, scoped to this list (the Collapse itself is unchanged): 14/22 regular on --aha-gray-15 (the lab's 2% grey fill), 52px high, a hairline under it when open.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.
